_comment: Per-entity status overlay keyed by id (ADM0_A3). The builder derives sovereign/dependency/disputed from NE's TYPE field + UN membership; entries here OVERRIDE flags and attach a note. They may also set centroid [lng,lat] and radiusKm to give a country a RADIAL hitbox instead of relying on its polygon (for tiny / bad-polygon countries). UN membership lives in un-members.json; do NOT put unMember/unObserver here.

VAT.note: Vatican City — micro-polygon, use a radial hitbox

MDV.note: Maldives — atoll chain, use a radial hitbox
